decisions.reason: Devore decoration fabrics are fashion-driven and often rotated out after a few seasons, but the firm's emphasis on reorder continuity and stocked variants argues for keeping the line a while longer.
Transparent burnout sheers fit the core decoration range and serve retail reorders, though their design-led nature makes them candidates for collection rotation.
A single burnout design without variants is more exposed to seasonal collection updates, but it remains close to the established offer and is cheap to keep in stock.
Velour-like upholstery fabric is a durable staple with steady demand from upholstery customers and fits the firm's in-stock availability strategy.
A flame-retardant plain fabric serves contract and object customers with lasting regulatory demand, making it a stable basic in the range.
Satin-sheen polyester lining is a basic complement to the made-to-measure sewing business and is rarely subject to fashion rotation.
